FORTHE15TH STREET RAIL PROJECT
This MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING(hereinafter“MOU")is made and
entered into by and between, the Cheyenne Depot Museum Inc,121 W 15th Street, Ste 300,
Wyoming 82001 (hereinafter referred to as “MUSEUM"), and the City of Cheyenne,2101
O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82001 (hereinafter referred to as “CITY"), each is a
“Party”and, collectively, are the“Parties".
1. Purpose: In 2021, Cheyenne approved a Tourism Master Plan that included the
enthusiasts.In June 2022, the CITY received an Economic Development Administration grant
award of six hundred eight thousand four hundred dollars ($618,400)for the Cheyenne Railcar
Project to relocate and rehabilitate three railcars.In August 2022, the MUSEUM received a grant
award of four hundred eighty thousand dollars ($480,000) from the I David Donoho-A Friend
of the #844Fund, a fund of The Indianapolis Foundation for the restoration of Old Sadie, Steam
Engine No.1242. The Parties recognize that these funding sources will be used to complete
Phase 1 of the proposed Railcar Experience and this MOU will be used solely for the purpose of
providing restoration and critical infrastructure for the placement of Old Sadie and its asbestos
remediation and rehabilitation.
